text: This racing demo ships the two files a mod loader uses to inject code.
It's Voxotron, a hyper-speed racer where a run lasts thirty seconds and there are no brakes.
Now the build. Unity on Mono, and next to the exe: winhttp.dll, and doorstop_config.ini.
That pair is Unity Doorstop. Windows loads the fake winhttp, and your code runs before the game does.
Whether that's built-in mod support or a tool nobody removed, a file list can't say.
Worth a dip. Photon Fusion for eight-player races, and thirty-second runs.
Every demo I open, I read the file list first. That's the whole channel.
